$comment: Default reference set of `ouaf preview` (#30): a short selection of the reference face set test-media/faces/all.json (#31), varied and fast to render. `ouaf preview --references test-media/faces/all.json` renders on the full set, hard cases included. Fields: id (screenshot name), file (relative to this file: a clip rendered frame by frame from `from` to `time`, media time in s, the screenshot being the frame at `time`; or an image, rendered `frames` times, 10 by default), maxFaces (faces the host tracks), faces (faces the reference engine finds at the screenshot, checked by the browser tests: 0 for a negative or a hard case), description.

references.description: One face in close-up, frontal, mouth open
Close-up, frontal, dark skin, beard stubble, hand under the chin
Older man, white beard and moustache, glasses, black and white
Hijab and surgical mask: nose and mouth hidden
Three-quarter view, side light, long hair over one cheek
Selfie clip at 352×640 (low resolution), dark skin, talking
Two frontal faces, one above the other
Underwater footage without a face (negative case)
